name: Pictorio
desc: Turn a vocabulary list into picture flashcards. Choose clipart or photos, switch to scaffolded or blank labels for quizzing, then print or export to PowerPoint.
how: Paste or type your vocabulary, one word or phrase per line.
Pick clipart, photos or anything, and a grid size.
Switch labels to full, scaffolded or blank for quizzing.
Print the grid or export it to PowerPoint.
note: Pictures come from Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons, Openverse and Pexels. Each card shows its source and licence, and the PowerPoint export adds a credits slide.

name: Activity maker
desc: Turn a list of sentences or vocabulary into gap fills, jumbled sentences, match ups, missing letters and a sentence builder grid.

name: Sentence Builder Maker
desc: Build a sentence builder grid from your chosen structures, ready to display or print.

name: Morning Retrieval
desc: A quick retrieval starter for the first five minutes of a lesson.

name: Easy Cover
desc: Printable cover work from your key words, with a word bank, tasks and answers for the cover supervisor.

name: Translation practice builder
desc: Paste sentences in Spanish and English and get translation tasks in both directions, with model answers.

name: Lesson Prompt Generator
desc: Step by step prompts that help you plan a lesson with an AI assistant, so the output fits your class.

name: 90 word task planner
desc: Plan GCSE writing around the bullet points, with key structures and a paragraph frame.

name: Speaking mock helper
desc: Teacher scripts and mark scheme notes for running GCSE speaking mocks with a whole class.
